name: Necromancer audit: Gravedigger cuts Sacrifice Undead's cast time by 0.5 s (#1020)
contract: Gravedigger 704715 (CharacterAdvancement 29865, Class tab, class 23) reads 'Reduces the cast time of Sacrifice Undead by $/1000;S1 sec.' Spell.dbc: a passive whose effect 0 is aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) op 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -501 + DieSides 1 = -500 ms, class mask word 2 0x4000000 in family 29. Sacrifice Undead 805027 and its ranks 807938-807941 are family 29 with SpellFamilyFlags word 2 0x4000000 and SpellCastTimes 16 = 1500 ms. Unit::ModSpellCastTime applies SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME natively, so the talented cast takes 1000 ms and the untalented one 1500 ms; the talented cast finishes (and starts the 30 s cooldown) while an untalented cast begun just after it is still in progress.

steps.label: SETUP: the Gravedigger passive is active
CONTROL: the plain caster has no Gravedigger
CONTROL: Sacrifice Undead is a 1.5 s cast
Gravedigger makes Sacrifice Undead a 1.0 s cast
The reduction covers the highest Sacrifice Undead rank
The talented cast bar starts at 1.0 s
CONTROL: the untalented cast bar starts at 1.5 s
The talented cast finishes within 1.3 s
The talented cast completed and started its cooldown
CONTROL: the untalented cast is still in progress
